mapper.select: INSERT INTO user_profile ( user_id, major, grade, campus, degree, college, lifecycle_stage, course_records, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{profile.userId}, #{profile.major}, #{profile.grade}, #{profile.campus}, #{profile.degree}, #{profile.college}, #{profile.lifecycleStage}, #{profile.courseRecordsJson, typeHandler=xyz.v185v.collegeassistant.persistence.typehandler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET major = EXCLUDED.major, grade = EXCLUDED.grade, campus = EXCLUDED.campus, degree = EXCLUDED.degree, college = EXCLUDED.college, lifecycle_stage = EXCLUDED.lifecycle_stage, course_records = EXCLUDED.course_records, updated_at = now() RETURNING
